ara::crypto::cryp::Key-
DerivationFunctionCtx::AddSalt
shall add a
Salt

•
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyDerivationFunctionCtx::AddSalt
shall re-
turn a

Salt

ported by the
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId

(RS_CRYPTO_02101)
The
CryptoAPI
provides the
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyDerivationFunc-
tionCtx::AddSalt
interface in the
KDF
context. Deriving the key is done by the
given target symmetric algorithm identifier, which also defines a length of derived key.
